pageFooter.aboutText: - it's my account name across various selling platforms. I sell coins from my personal collection and more. Since I'm an amateur coins collector, I might make pricing mistakes - let me know if you see unfair price! I promise honest service and fast responses.
pageFooter.aboutTextAdditional: I have successfully completed many sales on various sites, and all buyers were happy. You can check it by feedbacks on next platforms:
pageFooter.iOffer: I offer international and domestic shipping.
pageFooter.iOffer2: You can select shipping method in order modal when click Buy.
pageFooter.packing: I pack all coins securely and hermetically, not detectable by touch when sent by mail envelope.
pageFooter.noTraceableRest: are not traceable and process of returning when it's lost may be impossible. But from my experience this kind of delivery works well even when sent abroad like China, Canada, Europe.
pageFooter.noTraceableAlert: By selecting priority mail as shipping method, the buyer understand the risks and will not claim any compensation in case of loss.
pageFooter.noTraceableProof: From my side, I provide proof of postage with a photo of the envelope and a video of dropping it into the postbox.
pageFooter.usaDeliveryFull: Shipping to the USA is only possible via private carriers (FedEx, UPS, GLS), as the Hungarian Post has suspended all parcel and letter services to the USA due to tariff issues.
pageFooter.mapTitle: Personal pickup available at - Budapest, 13 district
pageFooter.termsBooking: Booking - means that the coins become inactive on this site for 24 hours but remain available for purchase on other platforms (Vatera, Galeria Savaria, Aukro).
pageFooter.termsOrder: After purchase (before payment), the coins are removed from this site but remain active on other platforms (Vatera, Galeria Savaria, Aukro) until payment is confirmed.
pageFooter.termsAlert: Priority is given to listings on other platforms until payment is received
pageFooter.termsWarning: since it's hard to remove and add items on many platforms after any user action.
pageFooter.termsGreen: Coins can be withdrawn from sale by personal request and removed automatically by successfull payment transaction.
pageFooter.termsCondition: The condition of the coins is exactly as shown in the photos; no claims regarding their condition will be accepted after purchase.

toast.welcome:
Welcome to Denumismat.

 I happy to see you here! It's my coins catalog that I ready to sell.

How it works:
1. Sign in with Google in 2 clicks or with your email
2. Select the coins you like or want to buy
3. Click 'Book' to disable coins for another buyers or 'Buy' to purchase
4. After buying, I send you bank account number to pay and coins almost yours.
5. Coins will be removed from other platforms after payment confirmation.
